title: CMS-Integration-Guide-Builder Input
description: Input parameters for generating a CMS-specific ad integration onboarding guide.

cms_platform.description: The publisher's CMS or site framework. Examples: 'WordPress', 'Next.js', 'HTML', 'Webflow', 'Shopify', 'Ghost'. Unknown platforms receive generic instructions.

publisher_domain.description: The publisher's root domain (without protocol). Used to construct ads.txt verification URL and personalize the guide. Example: 'myblog.com'.
